title: Level-One Weight Bound by Majority Influence
statement: Let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be a Boolean function whose singleton Fourier coefficients are all equal, and suppose $n>0$. Its level-one Fourier weight is at most the square of the total influence of majority on the $n$-dimensional cube, divided by $n$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional cube
All singleton Fourier coefficients of $f$ are equal
